title: Pure Barbaros
summary: The Level 8 EARTH Beast-Warrior Barbaros engine paired with Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast, Rank 8 Xyz bosses, and generic staples. By Normal Summoning high-Level monsters without Tributing and resetting their stats or overlaying them, the deck combines 3000+ ATK beatdown with Rank 8 control.

summary.title: Starters & Normal Summon Cheating
points: Beast King Barbaros Normal Summons itself without Tributing as a 1900 ATK Level 8 Beast-Warrior, or Tributes 3 monsters to destroy all cards the opponent controls.
Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast Normal Summons or Sets itself without Tributing at halved stats (1400 ATK / 1000 DEF) and provides the Machine Type required for Beast Machine King Barbaros Ür.
King Beast Barbaros Special Summons itself from the hand by Tributing monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more, turning any single Level 8 Barbaros on the field into an immediate follow-up.

summary.title: Opening: Trade-In + Beast Machine King Barbaros Ür
steps: Activate Trade-In by discarding Beast King Barbaros or King Beast Barbaros to draw 2 cards while loading a Level 8 Beast-Warrior into the GY.
Normal Summon Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast without Tributing, or banish a Machine and a Beast-Warrior from the hand, field, or GY to Special Summon Beast Machine King Barbaros Ür at 3800 ATK.

Normal Summon Beast King Barbaros without Tributing alongside Barbaros Ür or King Beast Barbaros, then overlay the two Level 8s into Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy or Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star.

summary.title: ATK Reset & Skill Drain Synergy
summary.text: Both Beast King Barbaros and Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast only lose their original ATK through their own continuous effects when Normal Summoned without Tributing. Flipping Skill Drain negates all face-up monster effects on the field while immediately restoring Beast King Barbaros to 3000 ATK and Fusilier Dragon to 2800 ATK, and it also removes Beast Machine King Barbaros Ür's no-battle-damage restriction. Forbidden Chalice performs the same trick during the Damage Step, negating Beast King Barbaros to jump its ATK to 3400 for the turn and permanently resetting it to 3000 afterward.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: King Beast Barbaros Tributes a Barbaros monster to destroy 2 cards the opponent controls, and can attack all monsters the opponent controls.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy negates a Spell effect on the field and attaches it as Xyz Material, while redirecting opposing attacks onto itself.
Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star sends an opposing card to the GY without targeting or destroying on summon, and detaches a material to protect your board from destruction.
Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder stacks on top of any Rank 8 Xyz or Zoodiac Chakanine after battle to send all other cards on the field to the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Fire Formation - Tenki stays on the field to grant all Beast-Warrior Barbaros monsters a 100 ATK boost.
Trade-In converts redundant Level 8 Barbaros monsters in hand into 2 fresh draws while stocking the GY for Beast Machine King Barbaros Ür.
Forbidden Chalice and Skill Drain double as monster effect disruption against the opponent and permanent stat resets for your no-Tribute Normal Summons.

allow.Forbidden Chalice: Quick-Play Spell that negates Beast King Barbaros's effect on the field, permanently resetting its ATK to 3000.
allow.Trade-In: Discards any Level 8 Barbaros monster to draw 2 cards while fueling the GY for Barbaros Ür.
allow.Skill Drain: Continuous Trap that negates all face-up monster effects, restoring Beast King Barbaros and Fusilier to their full original stats.
allow.Fire Formation - Tenki: Continuous Spell that searches any Level 4 Beast-Warrior or boosts all Barbaros monsters by 100 ATK.
allow.Zoodiac Chakanine: Beast-Warrior Xyz that provides extra Beast-Warrior bodies in the GY for Barbaros Ür.
allow.Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star: Rank 8 Xyz made with two Level 8 Barbaros monsters that sends an opposing card to the GY and protects from destruction.
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Xyz boss summoned via Level 8 Barbaros monsters that negates Spells and redirects attacks.
allow.Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder: Ranks up over combat-oriented Rank 8 Xyz monsters to wipe the board.
